title: LatentRouter: Can We Choose the Right Multimodal Large Language Model Before Seeing Its Answer?
abstract: arXiv:2605.11301v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have heterogeneous strengths across OCR, chart understanding, spatial reasoning, visual question answering, cost, and latency. Effective MLLM routing therefore requires more than estimating query difficulty: a router must match the multimodal requirements of the current image-question input with the capabilities of each candidate model. We propose LatentRouter, a router that formulates MLLM routing as counterfactual multimodal utility prediction. Given an image-question query, LatentRouter extracts learned multimodal routing capsules, represents each candidate MLLM with a model capability token, and performs latent communication between these states to estimate how each model would perform if selected. A distributional outcome head predicts model-specific counterfactual quality, while a bounded capsule correction refines close decisions without allowing residual signals to dominate the predict

translated_title: LatentRouter：我们能在看到答案之前选对多模态大语言模型吗？
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在OCR、图表理解、空间推理、视觉问答、成本和延迟等方面具有各不相同的优势。因此，有效的MLLM路由不仅仅是估计查询难度：路由器必须将当前图像-问题输入的多模态需求与每个候选模型的能力相匹配。我们提出了LatentRouter，这是一个将MLLM路由形式化为反事实多模态效用预测的路由器。给定一个图像-问题查询，LatentRouter提取学习到的多模态路由胶囊，用模型能力token表示每个候选MLLM，并在这些状态之间执行潜在通信，以估计每个模型如果被选中时的表现。分布式的结果预测头预测模型特定的反事实质量，同时有界的胶囊修正机制细化接近的决策，而不让残差信号主导预测。
tldr: 该论文提出LatentRouter框架，将多模态大语言模型路由建模为反事实多模态效用预测问题，通过路由胶囊与模型能力token之间的潜在通信，在看到模型答案之前预测并选出最适合当前图像-问题查询的模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LatentRouter, a routing framework that formulates MLLM routing as counterfactual multimodal utility prediction, using latent communication between routing capsules and model capability tokens to predict and select the best-suited multimodal large language model for an image-question query before seeing its answer.
